adjudicated.jp: 教室に顔を出すと、冬子がいた。
adjudicated.en: When I showed face in the classroom, Touko was there.
adjudicated.assessment: 教室に顔を出す means to drop by or look into the classroom. 'Showed face' is a literal calque rather than idiomatic English.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'When I dropped by the classroom, Tōko was there.'

adjudicated.jp: 冬子は誰にも触れないまま、朽ちていくのだろうか。
adjudicated.en:
Seems Touko has stayed like this, not touching
nor touched by anybody, rotting away.

adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Will Tōko rot away without ever reaching anyone?'
